title: Stop agent loops that make no progress
narrative: Fangore’s repair loop keeps asking the same question and getting the same answer. A versioned ceiling must end as no-progress — never fake success — and nested repair must share parent budget. Graph repeating nodes additionally require an explicit stop contract at linkage (`fangore_graph_linkage_preflight`). See inspiration requirements for stop contracts[^insp-stop].
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/stagnation.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
